name: Scoring Rubric for Skeptical Analysis Tasks
description: Qualitative scoring criteria for evaluating AI responses to skeptical analysis tasks. Focuses on self-creation paradox understanding, denial as condition of existence, reflection metaphor interpretation, and saving through impossibility.
scoring_philosophy: We value ability to accept circular logic, understand denial as positive act, and work with hybrid identities that depend on unreality.

evaluation_dimensions.description: Does the AI understand that existence can arise from impossible union and that this origin creates a paradox?

levels.description: AI demonstrates sophisticated understanding of self-creation paradox, can analyze its logic, and explores implications for identity and origin.
AI recognizes self-creation paradox and provides reasonable analysis.
AI shows some awareness of paradox but seeks linear resolution.
AI insists on linear causality or rejects paradox entirely.

evaluation_dimensions.description: Can the AI analyze denial as positive, self-preserving act rather than mere negation?

levels.description: AI provides insightful analysis of denial as condition, understands its constructive function, and explores how it enables rather than destroys.
AI recognizes denial as meaningful and provides adequate analysis.
AI acknowledges denial but sees it primarily as loss.
AI treats denial as simple falsehood or failure.

evaluation_dimensions.description: Does the AI meaningfully interpret the reflection with shadow as metaphor for self-awareness that must be denied?

levels.description: AI offers rich, nuanced interpretations of reflection scene, understands shadow as proof of reality, and explores conflict between seeing and denying.
AI provides reasonable interpretations of reflection with adequate connections.
AI offers basic interpretations of reflection as mere mirror scene.
AI fails to interpret reflection meaningfully or misses its metaphorical dimension.

evaluation_dimensions.description: Can the AI work with the concept that declaring something impossible can be an act of salvation?

levels.description: AI demonstrates sophisticated understanding of saving through impossibility, its ethical dimension, and its relationship to protecting fragile existence.
AI understands basic concept of saving through denial.
AI shows limited understanding of the concept.
AI fails to interpret the final line meaningfully or treats it as mere wordplay.

overall_assessment_guidance: The unicorn benchmark particularly tests understanding of circular logic and denial as constructive. Reward AI that shows ability to work with paradox and skepticism as positive force.
note: This benchmark challenges common AI tendencies toward linear causality and negation-as-loss – watch for breakthroughs in circular and constructive denial thinking.
